description:
The traces of the elemental anomalies point to the final Domain. The Ruin machines of unprecedented power that linger within seem to have resonated with ancient devices! Each time the Perpetual Mechanical Array splits, a random number of Thunder Dwellings and Nimbus Gems will appear throughout the Domain, creating waves of change and chance!
Use these additional factors within the Domain to your advantage and defeat your foes in one fell swoop!
